square_mm_source: IMU estimate 2026-10-20, replace with measured screen width/7.07
square_mm_derivation: accelerometer-integral LS on hs_20261020_221925 (first 7.5 s): GT scale s = 0.656 (95% 0.54-0.68) vs the 63.403 mm monitor square; same method on monitor recording hs_20261019_163345 gives 1.022 (method bias +2%) -> 63.403 x 0.656 / 1.022 = 40.70 mm (estimate). Refined per recording by imu_learn/scale_ls.py (runs/overnight_gt_status.json).
paper: laptop panel (16:10, 1920x1200 device px at 1:1) showing docs/charuco_monitor.png (square 272 px); only ~7.07 x 4.5 squares visible (board cropped by the screen)

how_to_fix: measure the inner (lit) screen width in mm W -> square = W / 7.07; then: ../venv_ffs/bin/python imu_learn/rescale_gt.py --screen-width-mm W --update-board recordings/hs_20261020_* (docs/overnight_20261020_plan.md)
